messages:
Anya Patel: Hey team — putting together a PRD for a privacy-preserving audit logging feature for Redwood Private/Dedicated. Goal: provide SOC2/ISO-grade evidence without exposing PII, and support KMS/HSM key attestation and cross-region failover. Draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/prd/audit-privacy (please don't leak)
Sam Ortiz: reading it now. Quick Q: do we need per-tenant retention policies or one org-wide retention with exceptions?
Lena (compliance): per-tenant retention is preferred. Some customers (legal holds, regulated) will require longer retention. Acceptance criteria should include an admin override with audit trail and justification field.
Maria Chen: +1 for per-tenant. Also need deterministic hashing for user IDs in logs so we can show counts without raw IDs.
Ethan Green: thinking about HSM edge cases — when the HSM is offline for rotation, how do we ensure logs remain verifiable? We could sign logs with a short-lived ephemeral key and then re-sign/anchor to HSM once rotation completes.
Anya Patel: good point. Proposed acceptance criteria snippets (draft):
- All audit entries must be tamper-evident (append-only, signed or HMACed) and verifiable by security team.
- Raw PII must never be stored in plaintext; implement per-tenant pseudonymization with deterministic salt stored in customer KMS where available.
- Support KMS-backed salts (customer-managed KMS) and host-managed fallback with clear documentation.
- Provide retention policy UI + API with ability to set legal-hold flag and export for e-discovery.
- Provide export proof bundle: logs .ndjson + signature manifest + verification key info.
Lena (compliance): add: evidence for SOC2 — we need runbooks showing: key rotation, how signatures are validated, and sample verification scripts. Also retention deletion proof (delete audit + tombstone + audit of deletion).
Sam Ortiz: for rollout gates, suggest: RFC approved -> feature-flagged beta -> external cust pilot (2 customers) -> GA. Beta must include export verification tests and at least one HSM integration test.
Maria Chen: edge case: cross-region replay — if requests routed to a failover region, logs must include origin-region and original timestamp. Also ensure ordering for append-only ledger across regions.
Ethan Green: sketch of a log entry format (example):
```json
{"evt": "model_request", "tenant": "t-12345", "uid_hash": "sha256:abcd...", "region": "us-east-1", "ts": "2026-04-02T18:12:34Z", "meta": {"model": "gpt-xx", "latency_ms": 32}}
```
Anya Patel: note: uid_hash should be computed as HMAC(salt, user_id) where salt is per-tenant. If customer KMS used, salt lives in their KMS and we call a wrap/unwrap or derive API; if not, we use host salt that must be scoped and rotated.
Lena (compliance): legal hold requirements: when legal_hold=true, retention overrides apply and deletion endpoints return 409 with rationale. Must surface evidence in exports that indicates legal hold status and who set it.
Sam Ortiz: tests to include in PRD: rotation resiliency (simulate HSM downtime), export verification (offline verify script), retention enforcement (delete+prove), cross-region ordering tests.
Maria Chen: UX notes: admin console should show retention timeline, current salt key id (masked), legal hold list, and a one-click export with signed bundle.
pr-review-bot: PRD checklist: acceptance criteria, security review, infra cost estimate, API contract, telemetry spec, QA plan, rollbacks documented.
Anya Patel: decision items I want to lock in here:
1) Support both customer-KMS and host-KMS flows — agreed? (Sam/Maria/Lena)
2) Require tamper-evidence via HMAC/signatures for GA.
3) Retention must be per-tenant with legal-hold override and export proof bundle.
4) Add cross-region ordering field and include original-region metadata.
Sam Ortiz: +1 for 1-4. Will add infra cost estimate to PRD.
Maria Chen: +1. I'll draft the pseudonymization RFC section and include example code for deriving uid_hash.
Ethan Green: will prototype ephemeral signing flow for HSM rotation and add test plan steps.
Lena (compliance): I'll produce required SOC2 evidence list and a short runbook for auditors.
Anya Patel: timeline proposal: RFC by EOD Friday, engineering spike week after, RFC review next Wed, beta in 6 weeks. Anyone blocked?
Sam Ortiz: blocked on capacity allocation — will confirm with Eng Leads by EOD.
Maria Chen: no blockers from product side.
Ethan Green: need a spare HSM test slot provisioned — pinging infra.
deploy-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance on staging HSM cluster 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC.
Anya Patel: thanks — we'll work around it for the spike. Final ask: please leave short reactions on the PRD doc with items you own. I'll merge changes and then open the RFC in the repo.
Maria Chen: added TODOs in doc and assigned myself for pseudonymization section.
Lena (compliance): added SOC2 checklist and sample auditor questions.
Sam Ortiz: marking infra follow-up in Asana.
Anya Patel: great — putting this in the RFC queue. Thanks everyone :rocket:
